documents.title: Synthetic Geological Note 01
documents.content:
# Synthetic Aurora Deposit 1

Synthetic demonstration document. It does not describe a real survey site.

Synthetic Aurora Deposit 1 is hosted in Synthetic Lumen Granite 1. It is controlled by Synthetic Meridian Fault 1, formed in Synthetic Epoch Alpha 1, and lies in Synthetic Northfield Region 1. The evidence is fictional and isMock=true.
